note: Small flat-roofed garden shed at the east fence of the ZS Sokolikova grounds by Kudlakova 2 (register S66, OSM way 1469186807, ~5 x 5 m; reconstruction): camera ~2.0 m high on the trodden yard edge ~11 m west of the shed, looking E. Horizon y 420; the shed front wall stands on y 700 (~140 px per metre), x 900-1600, roof edge y 336; front edge of the walk area y 1015 (~300 px per metre). Perspective s(y) = (y - 420) / 595. The four-storey Kudlakova 2 panel block (same early-1970s type as the carl_eric photo) fills the background ~40 m away (foot hidden behind the shed, roof y ~30); the grounds' wire-mesh fence with bare trees runs across behind the shed (~16 m, foot y ~605). The open door leaf stands out to y ~737, so the walk polygon is notched in front of it. Props where they are: the plank door open (leaf swung out to the left), the path-routing plan pinned on a board right of the door under the roof overhang, the shovel leaning on the wall right of the board, a stack of laths for the tree guards leaning on the wall left of the door; Simon stands outdoors in front of the laths.
